title: The Sopranos Syndicate Tracker
summary: FBI intelligence dashboard built with ASP.NET Core MVC and MySQL to model organized crime hierarchies, multi-table associate networks, and financial collection logs.
problem: Law enforcement intelligence operations require tracking complex, multi-tiered criminal syndicates and revenue flows without relying on unstructured or flat data models.
approach: I designed a normalized 6-table relational MySQL schema and developed an ASP.NET Core MVC application with ADO.NET analytical queries for dynamic financial aggregation.
outcome: Delivered a fully containerized intelligence platform deployed to Railway featuring real-time organizational analytics.
designChoices: Normalized 6-Table Relational Schema: Modeled crime families, crews, mobsters, associates, business fronts, and collection logs with strict foreign key relationships.
SQL-First Query Workflow: Wrote and validated raw MySQL queries prior to C# ADO.NET controller integration to isolate and verify analytical query logic.
Hierarchical Financial Aggregation: Constructed multi-table INNER JOINs with SUM, GROUP BY, and dynamic LIMIT operations to generate crew and business front revenue reports.
Containerized Cloud Operations: Deployed compiled Release binaries to Railway with environment-based connection string configuration for production deployment.
